channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula diz só comentará sobre novo tarifaço dos Estados Unidos depois que Trump se manifestar
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he will only comment on the new U.S. tariffs after President Donald Trump makes a public statement. He said he prefers to focus on issues like the SUS, the women's health caravan, and women's treatment during his visit to the Women's Health Caravan in Rio de Janeiro. Lula emphasized that when Trump speaks, he will respond to show that 'in Brazil, no one gains from lying'.

item.title: Quaest: 87% não pretendem entrar em grupos de WhatsApp de política nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Quaest/Genial poll shows 87% of Brazilians do not intend to join political WhatsApp groups ahead of the 2026 elections, preferring to follow candidate interviews, news, and government proposals. Only 11% said they plan to participate in such groups, while 24% said they would attend in-person campaign events. Social media engagement is split: 47% plan to follow campaigns online, versus 48% who will not.

item.title: Mendonça assume ação de Caiado contra Boulos no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça has been assigned to oversee the criminal complaint filed by Goiás Governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) against Minister Guilherme Boulos of the Lula administration. Caiado alleges Boulos committed crimes, though specific details were not provided in the excerpt. The political dispute between the two has now reached the Supreme Court.

item.title: Lula prepara recepção especial a líder coreano com foco em defesa
item.description: President Lula will host South Korean President Lee Jae-myung for a state visit to Brazil in the last week of July 2026. The agenda includes a cultural reception at Itamaraty, official engagements in Brasília — some at the Palácio da Alvorada — and a business-focused agenda in São Paulo centered on defense, technology, and trade. Key topics include expanding Embraer’s KC-390 presence in South Korea, scientific and technological cooperation, sustainability, and potential discussions on U.S. trade tariffs.

item.title: Valdemar Costa Neto a VEJA: ‘Isso não é uma eleição, é uma guerra’
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, claims the 2026 presidential election will be a 'war' against Lula, citing investigations into alleged billions in pension fund fraud at INSS involving Lula’s son, Lulinha, as a political weapon for the right. He also notes that Flávio Bolsonaro, the party’s presidential candidate, will be compelled to testify before the STF over accusations of links to international drug trafficking, per a ruling by Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: O tom que Lula pediu que ministros adotassem para responder ao tarifaço
item.description: President Lula urged his ministers to respond with 'grit' to the new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, likening the needed attitude to Argentina’s victory over England in the World Cup. He instructed them to respond firmly, denouncing the measure as unjust, while leaving room for dialogue to expand exceptions and reverse what is possible.

item.title: Eduardo posta vídeo de IA com Bolsonaro criança e Flávio eleito
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro shared an AI-generated video showing Jair Bolsonaro conversing with his childhood self in English, while Flávio Bolsonaro appears as the elected president in 2026, wearing the presidential sash. The video symbolizes the family's electoral victory in 2026 and reinforces narratives of political legacy and resistance.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra sinal de alerta para Flávio Bolsonaro na direita
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) losing support among both non-bolsonarist right-wing voters (from 44% to 32%) and bolsonarist voters (from 50% to 45%) between June and July 2026, indicating weakening strength in his base. The survey also indicates that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads the presidential race in all scenarios against Flávio Bolsonaro and other opponents. The Banco Master scandal was tested, but specific impacts were not detailed in the provided excerpt.

item.title: PT lança Patrus Ananias ao Governo de Minas na segunda e PSB sinaliza apoio
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) in Minas Gerais is set to announce on Monday (20) the pre-candidacy of Patrus Ananias for state governor, following a meeting with President Lula at the Planalto Palace. The PSB, which had been backing the pre-candidacy of former Attorney General Jarbas Soares, is now negotiating support for the PT candidate.

item.title: Defender mulher de agressor é pauta de direita, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL-RJ pre-candidate for president, claims defending women from aggressors is a right-wing priority and proposes guaranteeing internet access for 70 million women as a tool for female emancipation through digital transformation. He criticizes Lula’s government as 'analog' and cites his father Jair Bolsonaro’s partnership with Starlink as a model for expanding connectivity in remote areas.

item.title: Brasil troca pragmatismo externo por retórica política. E colhe os resultados
item.description: Brazil has replaced pragmatic foreign policy with political rhetoric in its relations with the United States, leading to the imposition of a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods by the Trump administration. This shift, driven by nationalist rhetoric and blame-shifting toward the Bolsonaro family, boosted Lula’s popularity but incurred real economic costs. Despite the Bolsonaros’ recent shift in stance, public opinion, per a Quaest poll, largely holds them responsible for the tariffs.

item.title: A avaliação da China sobre o tarifaço de Trump contra o Brasil
item.description: China criticized the new 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods, stating there are no winners in a tariff war and that it is ready to work with Brazil to defend multilateralism. Spokesperson Lin Jian emphasized that such measures serve no one's interests and reaffirmed support for the WTO system. China's stance reflects concern over the impact on global trade relations and Brazil's economic stability.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral remove vídeo e multa Derrite por propaganda antecipada
item.description: São Paulo’s Electoral Justice ordered federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) to remove a video and pay a R$5,000 fine for premature electoral campaigning. In the recording, Derrite explicitly urged votes for himself, allies, and candidates including Tarcísio de Freitas, André do Prado, Guilherme Piaí, and Flávio Bolsonaro — constituting campaign activity before the official August 16 start date. Judge Claudia Fanucchi ruled the content amounted to a direct vote request, prohibited during the pre-candidacy phase.

item.title: Tendência de queda de Flávio Bolsonaro em pesquisa coincide com aumento de indecisos, aponta Quaest
item.description: The Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro dropping from 33% to 28% in voting intentions, while undecided voters rose from 5% to 11%, coinciding with controversy over his alleged money demands to fund the 'Dark Horse' film. Lula remains stable at 40%, and no non-Bolsonarist right-wing candidates (Caiado, Zema, Renan Santos) have gained traction from Flávio’s declining support, highlighting their low visibility and high voter unfamiliarity.

item.title: Celina Leão não garante candidatura de Michelle, mas diz que 'vai trabalhar' para que ela concorra ao Senado
item.description: Federal District Governor Celina Leão (PP) advocates for Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) to run for Senate on her ticket, but stresses the decision rests solely with the former first lady, who has not yet publicly declared her candidacy. Despite leading in voter intention polls, Michelle’s relationship with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) has deteriorated, prompting her to step down as head of PL Women’s National and casting uncertainty over her 2026 electoral ambitions.

item.title: A derrota de Ciro Nogueira ao tentar derrubar enquete sobre a eleição
item.description: The Piauí Regional Electoral Court rejected a petition by Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP) to remove an online poll testing his potential performance in a race for the Chamber of Deputies. The court ruled that, since no official candidacies have been registered yet, the poll does not constitute false information or serious decontextualization. Nogueira, who says he is running for Senate re-election, argued the poll could confuse voters.

item.title: A decisão de Lula sobre a disputa entre Dino e Nunes Marques por vaga em tribunal
item.description: President Lula has already signaled to allies how he will handle the dispute over the appointment of the next member of the TRF-1, following the retirement of Judge Novély Vilanova. The vacancy has become a battleground of internal STF lobbying, with ministers backing different candidates, including Flávio Dino and Nunes Marques. The exclusive article notes Lula has indicated his stance to allies.

item.title: Voto cruzado na Bahia tem santinho de ACM Neto, ex-ministro de Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: ACM Neto, the pre-candidate for governor of Bahia, is using santinhos featuring Lula’s image to gain votes in the interior, despite denying direct association. The strategy mirrors the cross-voting seen in 2022, when Lula won 72% of the vote in the state. João Roma, a senatorial pre-candidate, denies producing the material and states he openly supports Flávio Bolsonaro for president.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral inicia habilitação de locais de votação para as Eleições 2026
item.description: The Electoral Justice begins the period for enabling or creating voting locations in municipalities with over 100,000 voters, with a deadline of August 20. This Friday also marks the deadline to establish voting sites in penal and socioeducational units, as set by TSE Resolutions nº 23.759/2026 and nº 23.760/2026.

item.title: Lula conversa com presidente austríaco sobre democracia e conflitos
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva received a phone call from Austrian President Alexander Van der Bellen to discuss global conflicts, multilateralism challenges, democracy, and the environment. Both leaders expressed concern over the escalation of armed conflicts, citing the resumption of hostilities between the U.S. and Iran in the Middle East. Van der Bellen also requested that Lula record a message for the 50th anniversary celebrations of the Bruno Kreisky Prize in Vienna in October 2026, an award Lula received in 1984 for his work defending workers' rights and democracy during the military dictatorship.

item.title: PT vai anunciar nome de Patrus Ananias como candidato em Minas na próxima segunda
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) has announced that federal deputy Patrus Ananias, former mayor of Belo Horizonte, will be its candidate for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026. The announcement will be made next Monday (20), following an internal decision on Thursday (16). The move aims to rebuild the party's image in the state, which is considered pivotal for Lula's re-election, as Minas Gerais has historically mirrored the national presidential vote.

item.title: Caiado critica declaração de Marco Rubio sobre Lula e tarifaço: ‘Infeliz’
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's remarks about President Lula, calling them 'unfortunate' and arguing that Brazil should not be punished due to personal disagreements between leaders. Caiado said the 25% tariff on Brazilian imports harms working Brazilians and that the country is greater than such retaliations. The Brazilian Foreign Ministry, through Minister Mauro Vieira, also rebutted Rubio, labeling his comments arrogant and announcing Brazil will invoke the Reciprocity Law and bring the case to the WTO.

item.title: Governo brasileiro se prepara para tarifa extra de 12,5% de Trump
item.description: The Brazilian government is preparing for the potential imposition of a 12.5% additional tariff on its exports by the United States, linked to alleged shortcomings in combating forced labor, which could be added to a previously announced 25% surcharge based on Section 301 of U.S. trade law. Officials assess that the room to avoid these tariffs is limited, as the USTR has completed its investigations and issued formal recommendations, while continuing to present technical arguments.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Tarifaço de Trump: filho feio não tem pai, nem pensão
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program analyzed the impact of Donald Trump's 25% tariff on Brazilian products, highlighting the initial measures announced by the Lula government to mitigate economic effects. It also discussed the new justification provided by authorities regarding Brazil's trade policy in response to escalating American protectionism.

item.title: Tarcísio prepara decreto para mudar elaboração de leis em São Paulo
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas is preparing a decree to change São Paulo's normative governance, altering how laws, decrees, and resolutions are drafted. Confirmed by the São Paulo Civil House, the measure aims to modernize the state's legislative process and will be published in the coming days.

item.title: Antes da carta, Flávio foi única visita a Bolsonaro autorizada por Moraes na semana
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) was the only person authorized to visit former President Jair Bolsonaro between July 9 and 15, according to a report from the Federal District Military Police sent to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The document also states that Bolsonaro carried out no other activities during that period.

item.title: Atacar o Pix é como dizer que 'criar saneamento compromete o carro-pipa'; veja reações do governo às críticas dos EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government rejected U.S. accusations of unfair trade practices, calling the 25% tariff political and lacking technical basis. Responses focused on defending Pix as a free, open public infrastructure, comparing U.S. criticism to claiming that 'building basic sanitation would hurt water truck revenues'. The government also rebutted allegations in areas such as intellectual property, anti-corruption, and ethanol market access, stating the accusations are unfounded and harmful to bilateral dialogue.

item.title: Justiça rejeita ação de Flávio Bolsonaro contra usuário do X que o chamou de ‘miliciano’
item.description: Judge Gabriela Jardon Guimarães de Faria of the TJ-DF dismissed a lawsuit filed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against an X user who called him a 'miliciano', 'money launderer', 'criminal', and 'thief'. The ruling held that the statements were based on press reports and existing political accusations, with no evidence of fabricated falsehoods. The low reach of the post (48 views, 3 likes, 1 comment) and Bolsonaro's status as a hyper-public figure were also cited to deny moral damages.

item.title: Resistência à vice favorita de Flávio Bolsonaro abre novo racha no PL
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's attempt to nominate Daniella Marques as vice president is facing resistance within the PL and Republicanos parties, criticized for her lack of electoral experience and limited party influence. Despite her technical role in drafting the government plan and leading the 'Brasil por Elas' event, party leaders argue she would not bring electoral votes or expand alliances. The resistance highlights a growing rift in the pre-campaign, with concerns over decision-making being concentrated in a small inner circle.

item.title: PIB, Eleições, e a Seleção Brasileira (por Ricardo Guedes)
item.description: The text analyzes the relationship between Brazil's GDP and electoral outcomes, arguing that economic growth favors incumbent re-election while decline leads to defeat. Citing examples from 1992 to 2023, it shows how GDP influenced elections of Itamar, FHC, Lula, Dilma, Temer, and Bolsonaro. It also draws a parallel between economic performance and the Brazilian national team's success, suggesting social well-being affects both electoral and sporting outcomes.

item.title: Calúnia contra Lula: Moraes diz que Flávio não comprovou pedido para adiar depoimento
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied the defense’s request to postpone Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s testimony in the slander case against President Lula, stating no proof of inability to appear was provided. The testimony was scheduled for July 28, despite PF contacts with the defense, which failed to select a date or time. The PF concluded that Bolsonaro committed slander by falsely linking Lula to drug and arms trafficking, money laundering, and support for dictatorships in a January social media post.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro surge malhando em canal de influencer, e web compara com vídeos de Lula
item.description: A video of Flávio Bolsonaro working out at a gym went viral on social media, with supporters praising his physical preparation and critics comparing it to President Lula’s viral exercise videos, used to counter age-related attacks. The senator mentioned knee and shoulder surgeries and was called 'unbreakable' by influencer Julio Balestrin, a term linked to his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The clip sparked debate over public image, age, and physical readiness in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Flávio está perdendo a direita
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro retains 91% support among Bolsonarist voters, but is losing ground in the broader right-wing electorate, according to Genial/Quaest data. The 'non-Bolsonarist right' is shifting toward other candidates or becoming more volatile, signaling an ideological fragmentation that Bolsonaro can no longer fully absorb. This erosion of right-wing cohesion could be decisive in the 2026 election outcome.

item.title: Moraes marca para 28 de julho depoimento de Flávio em inquérito sobre Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has scheduled the testimony of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for July 28 at 2 p.m. in an inquiry investigating possible slander against President Lula. Flávio had requested a postponement, which was denied. The case stems from allegations made by the senator against the president, currently under investigation by the STF.

item.title: O tarifaço vai pegar Lula na esquina?
item.description: Polls suggest Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has more to lose electorally from the new U.S. tariffs than President Lula, according to political scientist Leonardo Barreto. The economic impact of Trump’s tariffs is seen as a greater risk for Bolsonaro’s base.

item.title: Moraes marca para o dia 28 depoimento de Flávio em investigação de calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has scheduled the testimony of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for July 28 at 2 p.m. in the investigation into slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). The Federal Police will hear the senator as part of an inquiry into false accusations made by Bolsonaro against the head of the Executive. The deposition takes place amid rising political tensions between the government and allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Moraes marca depoimento de Flávio em inquérito de calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has scheduled Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s testimony for July 28 in an inquiry into alleged slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, following a social media post accusing Lula of international criminal activity. The decision came after the Federal Police submitted a final report indicating an offense against honor and the Attorney General’s Office deemed the testimony necessary to assess possible retraction. Flávio Bolsonaro’s defense claimed the investigation concluded without his testimony and requested documents from U.S. and Brazilian authorities.

item.title: A nova data para Flávio Bolsonaro depor à PF sobre calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has set July 28 at 2 p.m. for Flávio Bolsonaro’s testimony before the Federal Police regarding alleged slander against President Lula. The defense requested a delay due to pre-campaign commitments, but Moraes denied it, stating no proof of impossibility was provided. The investigation stems from a January 3 post on X linking Lula to drug trafficking, arms smuggling, money laundering, terrorist support, dictatorships, and election fraud.

item.title: Moraes manda PF ouvir Flávio Bolsonaro em 28/7 por acusação de calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the Federal Police to hear Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on July 28 over a defamation accusation against President Lula. The ruling followed a PF conclusion in late June that Bolsonaro linked Lula to Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in a social media post, implying Lula would be denounced for crimes including drug and arms trafficking. Bolsonaro’s defense requested more time due to pre-campaign commitments, but Moraes denied the request, stating no proof of scheduling impossibility was provided.

item.title: Moraes marca interrogatório de Flávio Bolsonaro em inquérito por suposta calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes has scheduled the interrogation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for July 28 in an inquiry into alleged slander against President Lula, after the senator’s defense failed to prove scheduling incompatibility. The case stems from a January post on X in which Bolsonaro linked Lula to international drug and arms trafficking and money laundering, which the Federal Police deemed an imputation of criminal facts. Moraes rejected all evidentiary requests by the defense, including hearings with Lula, Sergio Moro, and María Corina Machado, stating they would constitute improper interference in the investigation.

item.title: Moraes determina que Flávio Bolsonaro seja ouvido dia 28 de julho sobre suspeita de calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to be heard by the Federal Police on July 28 at 2 p.m. in an investigation into alleged slander against President Lula. The decision came after Bolsonaro’s defense failed to schedule the hearing within the allotted time, despite being given the opportunity to choose a date and time. The investigation stems from a January post on X in which Bolsonaro falsely linked Lula to international drug and arms trafficking and money laundering.

item.title: Moraes marca depoimento de Flávio em inquérito após PF apontar dificuldade
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes scheduled the testimony of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for July 28 in an inquiry into alleged slander against President Lula. The decision followed the Federal Police's report that they could not schedule the testimony within the 10-day deadline set by Moraes, despite having contacted the defense from the first day, including offering a videoconference. The defense claimed scheduling incompatibility due to Flávio’s pre-presidential campaign, but Moraes rejected the argument, ordering the testimony to ensure the regular progress of the investigation.

item.title: Eleita pelo PSL na onda bolsonarista, Soraya anuncia apoio de Lula para reeleição ao Senado
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB) announced that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) has confirmed his support for her Senate re-election bid in Mato Grosso do Sul. She maintained her independent candidacy after declining an offer to be Vander Loubet’s running mate, affirming continued collaboration with the petista deputy to strengthen the democratic field. Once known as 'Bolsonaro’s senator' from her 2018 election, Soraya cited Lula’s humanity and commitment to electing more women as key reasons for her political shift.

item.title: Áudio: CDH aprova sugestão que autoriza uso de fundos partidários em calamidades
item.description: The Human Rights Commission (CDH) approved a suggestion by Senator Márcio Bittar (PL-AC) to allow the use of Party and Electoral Fund resources to address public calamities. Suggestion SUG 9/2020, submitted via the e-Citizenship Portal, now proceeds as a bill.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula visita a Carreta de Saúde da Mulher, no Rio
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) visits the Women's Health Mobile Unit at ENSP/Fiocruz in Rio de Janeiro, where he will observe the insertion of a contraceptive implant provided by the SUS. At 3 p.m., he proceeds to the National Institute of Traumatology and Orthopedics (INTO), also in the city. The schedule underscores the federal government's commitment to women's health and access to specialized public health services.

item.title: Moraes marca para 28 de julho depoimento de Flávio Bolsonaro em caso de suspeita de calúnia contra Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has scheduled the testimony of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro before the Federal Police for July 28, 2026, at 2 p.m., in an investigation into alleged slander against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The probe stems from a January 3, 2026, post on X in which Bolsonaro accused Lula of drug trafficking, money laundering, and supporting dictatorships, while comparing him to Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro. Both the Federal Police and the Attorney General’s Office concluded the post constituted a false accusation of crime, and Moraes ordered the hearing after Bolsonaro’s defense failed to provide a scheduled time within the given deadline.

item.title: Nikolas critica ausência de Bolsonaro e o compara a Messi: 'Tirar o melhor jogador não desfalca o time?'
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized the imprisonment and restrictive measures imposed on Jair Bolsonaro, arguing that removing the former president from politics is like taking the best player off a team, harming the right in the 2026 elections. He compared the situation to a hypothetical absence of Lionel Messi in the World Cup final, asking whether that would not weaken the team. Nikolas also stated that millions of voters are being prevented from choosing Bolsonaro as a candidate.

item.title: Moraes assume comando interino do STF
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes assumes the interim presidency of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) starting this Friday, the 17th, during the second half of the judiciary recess. As vice-president of the Court, he will hold the position until the end of July, when only urgent requests will be processed by the on-duty panel.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Governo rebate novo tarifaço com adjetivos severos enquanto calcula resposta no campo econômico
item.description: The Brazilian government responded with harsh language to the new U.S. tariff increase, using terms like 'false', 'unjust', and 'illegal' to defend national sovereignty and avoid assigning blame for the measure to itself. The rhetoric aims to strengthen the government's political narrative while keeping economic response details — such as incentives for affected sectors or application of the Economic Reciprocity Law — unresolved. The strategy seeks to associate the tariff burden with the Bolsonaro clan in public opinion.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro torciam por adiamento do tarifaço e admitem prejuízos para campanha
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro regret the confirmation of the 25% additional U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods, effective July 22, as they had hoped for a delay to avoid electoral damage. The measure, resulting from a Section 301 investigation under the 1974 Trade Act, is blamed by Bolsonaro on Lula’s administration for poor trade negotiations, though polls show Brazilians largely blame Bolsonaro for the tariff and view Lula more favorably on the issue.
